ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher and record the driver's premature cancellation (no-show claim not supported).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat contains only pickup arrangement and cancellation notices [F9][F10]; no threat, harassment, sexual remark, abuse or dangerous-driving allegation, so no SAFE-1/SAFE-2 escalation. Evidence is complete and timestamped [F11], so evidence_status = sufficient.

NS-0 routes this to NS-1: the driver cancelled and claims rider no-show [F12]. Testing NS-1's three requirements:
(i) The driver did press "I'm Here" [F6], so (i) holds.
(ii) At the tap (13:02:35) GPS showed him 39 m from the pickup point [F6], within the 200 m data-layer radius, so (ii) holds.
(iii) NS-1(iii) requires continuous waiting at the pickup point for more than 3 minutes (≥ 3:01) after the tap. The record shows the opposite: the driver stayed within 200 m for only 2 min 55 s after the tap [F6] and cancelled at 13:05:30, i.e. 2 min 55 s after the tap. The alternative timeline read also fails: cancellation came 4 min 30 s after the platform-recorded arrival at 13:01:00 [F5], but the tap time controls under NS-1, and even on arrival time the stationary window was only 3 min 15 s [F3] ending in the cancellation. Either way the > 3 min continuous wait from the tap is not met. The driver's written claim of "waited more than 3 minutes" [F12] is a statement (chat/statement) that the system timeline records override, and the free-wait concept does not substitute for the no-show threshold.

Because NS-1(iii) fails, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee does not stand and must be refunded in full. Per NS-7 the refund issues as a voucher worth $6.61; no cash. The (ii) condition was satisfied (39 m ≤ 200 m [F6]), so the extra RD-6/NS-2 flag_account for tapping "I'm Here" while outside the pickup radius is not triggered. The traffic facts [F13][F14] and weather [F15] are irrelevant to a no-show dispute. Driver profile [F17] (1 upheld no-show in 90 d) is not relied on to decide this case.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement that he waited more than 3 minutes after tapping 'I'm Here' conflicts with system timeline/GPS records showing only 2 min 55 s within 200 m after the tap [F6] and cancellation at 13:05:30 [F4]; system records override statements, so NS-1(iii) is not satisfied.
Cumulative time within 200 m before cancellation (4 min 30 s) includes time before the 'I'm Here' tap; NS-1(iii) counts only continuous waiting after the tap, which was 2 min 55 s [F6].
